rows.reconciliation: page 47, the row `every issue, every year`: admin_fee 12,767.0 vs printed 12,764.0 ; interest 14,765,914.0 vs printed 14,765,895.0 ; principal 38,749,084.0 vs printed 38,749,085.0 ; total 53,527,763.0 vs printed 53,527,743.0
rows.read_by: claude-opus-5 reading render_page.swift output at scale 8, cropped in bands
rows.proof: The FY2022 debt repayment schedule as of June 30, 2022, BY ISSUE -- 14 borrowings against 25 fiscal years, printed sideways across pages 45 (FY2023-FY2037) and 47 (FY2038-FY2047 and the TOTAL column). 184 issue-years, 636 figures. Two identities: every issue-year returns principal plus interest plus MWPAT admin fee as its own TOTAL row, and every issue's years sum to the TOTAL column printed beside it on p47. AND IT RECONCILES TO THE GRAND TOTAL BLOCK the town prints on pages 46 and 48, which those two pages hold and which nothing in this archive had ever looked at: the fourteen issues sum, year by year, to GRAND TOTAL PRINCIPAL, GRAND TOTAL INTEREST and GRAND TOTAL MWPAT ADMIN FEES in all 25 years. THE PAGE PRINTS DISPLAYED WHOLE DOLLARS OVER AMOUNTS THAT CARRY CENTS, so a printed total is the ROUNDED SUM and not the sum of the rounded parts. What says that rather than a misread: every column with no cents beneath it ties EXACTLY -- all fourteen issues’ PRINCIPAL except the four Mass Water Pool loans, and the interest on GOB SCH OF 2014, GOB MPL OF 2017, DPW-ROADS GOB PML OF 2018 and both municipal purpose issues. Everything that misses is a MWPAT loan or a fractional-cent amortisation, and it misses by $1 to $8 across up to 25 displayed values, where the arithmetic bound is $12.50.
